一: One stroke, one thing: a single line counts as one.
二: Two lines stacked up make two.
三: Three lines, counted like tally marks, make three.
四: A nose breathing out through two nostrils: ancient scribes borrowed this picture for four, and the box has four sides.
五: Two bars with a cross between them: the crossing strokes sit like the five-spot on a die.
六: A little shed with a roof and two legs: picture six friends sheltering inside it.
七: Once a simple cross for cutting something in two: a line still slices through the hook.
八: Two strokes splitting apart: the old meaning was to divide, and eight divides neatly in half.
九: A bent arm with a hooked hand reaching out: nine is the last digit you can reach before ten.
十: A vertical and a horizontal crossed: all ten fingers folded together.
百: One (一) on top of white (白): one white sheet with a hundred marks on it.
千: A person (人) with one extra stroke: one person in a crowd of a thousand.
万: A huge swarm too big to count: draw 万 with a sweeping stroke and imagine ten thousand of anything.
上: A short mark sitting above a long line: it points up.
下: A short mark hanging below a long line: it points down.
中: A pole driven straight through the middle of a box.
人: A person seen from the side, striding along on two legs.
今: A lid (亼) coming down over a single moment: this one, right now.
休: A person (亻) leaning against a tree (木) to rest.
何: A person (亻) with a load on one shoulder, and the question: what is in there?
先: A foot stepping forward above a person's legs (儿): whoever walks ahead goes first.
入: An arrowhead pointing inward: two strokes slipping in through a tight opening.
円: A frame with a round coin rolling inside: one yen.
出: A foot stepping out of a cave: two stacked mountains now look like a path rising out of the hollow.
前: A foot on a boat moving forward: the bow always faces in front.
北: Two people sitting back to back, turning away from the cold north wind.
午: A pestle pounding upright: the sun stands straight above it at noon.
半: A knife splits a cow down the middle (八 over 牛): one half each side of the line.
南: A big bell hanging in its frame, the kind played in the warm south.
友: Two hands joined together (𠂇 and 又): friends shaking hands.
右: A right hand reaching to feed the mouth (口): the hand you eat with.
左: A left hand holding a tool (工): the right hand eats while the left one steadies the work.
名: In the evening (夕) dark no one can see you, so you use your mouth (口) to say your name.
国: A jewel (玉) guarded inside a walled border (囗): a country protects its treasure.
土: A mound of earth piled up on the ground.
外: Evening (夕) fortune-telling (卜) was done outside, under the open sky.
大: A person stretching their arms and legs out wide: this big!
天: A big person (大) with a line above their head: the sky above everyone.
女: A woman kneeling gracefully with her arms folded.
子: A swaddled baby with a big head and arms held out.
学: A child (子) under a roof while two hands pass down knowledge: a school.
小: Three tiny grains of sand: a line with a small dot either side.
山: Three mountain peaks, the tallest in the middle.
川: Three lines of water flowing down a river.
年: A person carrying grain on their back: one harvest marks one year.
後: A foot tied by a rope, dragging behind everyone else on the road (彳).
日: The sun, once a circle with a dot in the middle, now squared off.
時: The sun (日) beside a temple (寺): temple bells used to ring out the time of day.
書: A hand holding a brush (聿) over a page, writing in daylight (日).
月: A crescent moon with two lines of shadow across it.
木: A tree: branches spreading on top, roots reaching below.
本: A tree (木) with a mark at its base: the root, the origin, and later a book, where knowledge starts.
来: An ear of wheat, the grain that came down from the heavens as a gift: it has come.
東: The sun (日) rising behind a tree (木), so you must be facing east.
校: Wood (木) and mixing (交): pupils mixing together in a wooden schoolhouse.
母: A woman (女) with two dots added: a nursing mother.
毎: Every person (𠂉) has a mother (毋): every single one of us.
気: Steam (气) rising from cooking rice: the unseen air and energy around you.
水: A central stream with drops of water splashing out both sides.
火: A fire: flames leaping up with sparks flying off each side.
父: A hand holding a stone axe: the father out working with his tools.
生: A sprout pushing up out of the ground (一): new life is born.
男: Strength (力) in the rice field (田): a man working the land.
白: A single ray (丿) shining off the sun (日): bright, pure white.
聞: An ear (耳) pressed up to a gate (門): listening in.
行: A crossroads seen from above: you go along it.
西: A bird's nest: birds go to roost when the sun sets in the west.
見: A giant eye (目) on legs (儿): a person who is all about seeing.
話: Words (言) coming from the tongue (舌): talking.
語: Words (言) that I (吾) use: my language.
読: Say (言) the words out loud as you sell (売) your story: reading aloud.
車: A cart seen from above: one axle running through a wheel in the middle.
金: Nuggets (the two dots) buried under a roof in the earth (土): gold.
長: An elder with long, flowing hair.
間: The sun (日) shining through a gap in the gate (門): the space between.
雨: Raindrops falling from a cloud, under the line of the sky.
電: Rain (雨) above a bolt of lightning: electricity from the storm.
食: A lid opening over a bowl of rice: time to eat.
高: A tall building with a tower, roof and gate: it stands high.
不: A flower's calyx hanging from its stem, blocked by a line from rising: no.
世: Three tens (十) joined together: thirty years, one human generation.
主: A flame (丶) burning on top of a lamp stand: the master of the house keeps the light.
事: A hand holding a flag on a pole: doing the job, the matter at hand.
京: A tall palace rising above the city: the capital.
仕: A person (亻) serving as a samurai (士): working for a lord.
代: A person (亻) holding a stake (弋) in place until someone comes to substitute for them.
以: A person (人) carrying something along: by means of that tool, using it.
会: People (人) meeting beneath a cloud (云) of chatter: a gathering.
住: A person (亻) who is master (主) of the home they live in.
体: A person (亻) and their root (本): your body is what you're rooted in.
作: A person (亻) suddenly (乍) gets to work and makes something.
使: A person (亻) directing an official (吏): to use someone on a mission.
借: A person (亻) still owing for something from long ago (昔): to borrow.
元: A figure with two lines on top for a head: the head is where it all begins.
兄: A big mouth (口) on legs (儿): the elder brother giving everyone orders.
公: Private (厶) things split open (八) for all to see: public.
写: Under a cover (冖), give (与) the page a second life: copying.
冬: Slow footsteps (夂) over two drops of ice (冫): winter.
切: Seven (七) slices with a knife (刀): cut.
別: A knife (刂) separating bone from flesh: to split apart.
力: A flexed arm showing its muscle, or a plough pushed with strength.
勉: Even with an excuse (免), use your strength (力): exert yourself and study.
動: Heavy (重) things need strength (力) to move.
医: An arrow (矢) stored in a box (匸): a doctor removes the arrow and puts it away.
去: A person walking away from a doorway, leaving it behind.
口: An open mouth, seen from the front.
古: Ten (十) mouths (口) have handed down this tale: it is very old.
台: A stand with a mouth (口) under a nose (厶): a little platform to speak from.
同: A pipe with one end matching the other: both openings are the same.
味: The taste in your mouth (口) of fruit not yet (未) ripe: flavour.
品: Three boxes (口) stacked up: goods on a shelf.
員: A mouth (口) over a shell (貝): each member gets paid.
問: A mouth (口) at the gate (門): knocking to ask a question.
図: A map of the land drawn within a border (囗).
地: Earth (土) stretching out with a snake-like road across it (也): the ground.
堂: A grand building raised on a platform of earth (土): a hall.
場: Earth (土) with the sun rising over it (昜): an open place in the light.
売: A samurai (士) goes out to sell things from under a counter.
夏: A person standing under the scorching summer sun, feet dragging (夂).
夕: A crescent moon just rising: evening.
多: Two pieces of meat, one on top of the other: many, more than enough.
夜: Under a roof (亠) a person sleeps while the moon (夕) rises: night.
妹: A woman (女) who is not yet (未) grown: little sister.
姉: A woman (女) who goes to the market (市) for the family: big sister.
始: A woman (女) stepping up to the stand (台) to begin.
字: A child (子) under a roof (宀), learning characters.
安: A woman (女) seated safely under a roof (宀): at peace, relaxed.
室: Arrive (至) under a roof (宀): you've reached the room.
家: A pig (豕) under a roof (宀): a farming family's home.
少: A small (小) thing with a piece sliced off (丿): even fewer.
屋: Arrive (至) under an awning (尸): a house or shop.
工: A carpenter's square: the tool of a craftsperson.
帰: A person with a broom (帚) comes back home to sweep up.
広: A big roof (广) stretched out over open space: wide.
店: Under a roof (广), a fortune-teller (占) sets out a stall: a shop.
度: A hand (又) measuring out under a roof (广): degrees and occasions.
建: A hand planting a pole upright with a long stride (廴): to build.
弟: A strap wound around a spear handle in order: the younger brother comes next in line.
強: A bow (弓) drawn by a tough little bug (虫): strong.
待: Stand on the road (彳) at the temple (寺) and wait.
心: A heart with its chambers spread out across the page.
思: A field (田) of thoughts growing over the heart (心): to think.
急: A hand reaching out, grabbing your heart (心): hurry!
悪: An ugly mask (亜) over the heart (心): bad.
意: The sound (音) of your heart (心): your idea, your intention.
手: An open hand with the fingers spread, seen from the back.
持: A hand (扌) at the temple (寺) holding an offering.
教: A child (子) learning while a teacher holds a stick (攵): teach.
文: A person with a pattern tattooed on their chest: marks, then writing.
料: Rice (米) measured with a dipper (斗): the cost of the ingredients.
新: A freshly chopped tree, axe (斤) in hand: new wood.
方: A plough pointing the way: the direction you're heading.
旅: Under a flag, a group of people set off: a journey.
族: An arrow (矢) under a flag: a clan fighting together.
早: The sun (日) above a sprout (十): the early morning.
明: The sun (日) and moon (月) together: as bright as can be.
映: The sun (日) in the centre (央): reflecting its light on everything.
春: Sun (日) shining as sprouts push up through the grass: spring.
昼: Measure (尺) the day from dawn (旦): by midday the sun is at its height.
曜: The sun (日) beside a pheasant (翟) with shining feathers: days of the week were named after shining planets.
有: A hand reaching for meat (月): you have it.
服: A body (月) wearing what a hand has fitted: clothes.
朝: The sun rising through the grass while the moon (月) still shows: morning.
業: A busy rack of chime bells on a tree (木): craft and business.
楽: Bells and drums on a wooden (木) stand: music is fun.
歌: Two mouths (可 可) singing, with a big open yawn (欠): a song.
止: A footprint planted on the ground: stop.
正: A foot (止) stopped right at the line (一): correct.
歩: A stop (止) and few (少) more steps: walking.
死: Bones (歹) beside a person kneeling (匕) in mourning: death.
注: Water (氵) poured by the master (主): careful now, pour it in.
洋: Water (氵) as far as a flock of sheep (羊): an ocean full of white waves.
海: Water (氵) that every (毎) river flows into: the sea.
漢: Water (氵) from the Han river, which gave its name to China.
牛: A cow's head seen from the front, with two horns and ears.
物: A cow (牛) and a flag (勿) marking it as yours: a thing.
特: A bull (牛) at the temple (寺): a special offering.
犬: A big (大) dog with a dot for an ear.
理: Jade (王) polished by a village (里) expert to reveal its grain: logic.
用: A pipe fitted with a handle: a tool to use.
田: A rice field divided into four plots.
町: A field (田) with a street driven through it (丁): a town.
画: A brush tracing a field (田) in a frame: a picture.
界: Fields (田) with something between them (介): a boundary.
病: A person lying on a sickbed (疒) with a burning fever (丙).
発: A bow firing an arrow: off it goes!
目: An eye turned on its side: the pupil is between the lines.
真: Ten (十) tools (具) can prove it: true.
着: A sheep's (羊) wool in your eye (目): put on warm clothes.
知: An arrow (矢) from the mouth (口): knowledge flies out fast.
研: A stone (石) worn even (幵): polished, like a mind with study.
社: An altar (礻) on the soil (土): a shrine where a community gathers, and later a company.
私: Grain (禾) kept for myself (厶): private, I, me.
秋: Grain (禾) and fire (火): burning the fields after the autumn harvest.
究: Nine (九) times down the hole (穴): research goes deep.
空: A craftsperson (工) digs a hole (穴): an empty space, as open as the sky.
立: A person standing on the ground, arms out.
答: Bamboo (竹) strips that fit together (合): an answer matches its question.
紙: Thread (糸) from the clan (氏) workshop: fibres pressed into paper.
終: Thread (糸) finished by winter (冬): the end of the cord.
習: Wings (羽) over a white (白) chick learning to fly: practice.
考: An old person (耂) leaning on a cane (丂), deep in thought.
者: An old person (耂) under the sun (日): someone.
肉: Ribs of meat, seen in a slice.
自: A nose: in Japan, you still point at your nose to say myself.
色: A hand over a kneeling person: their face flushes with colour.
花: Grass (艹) that changes (化): a bud becoming a flower.
英: Grass (艹) with the finest in the centre (央): a hero, and England by sound.
茶: Grass (艹) above a person (人) and a tree (木): picking tea leaves.
親: Standing (立) on a tree (木) to see (見) the kids come home: a parent.
言: Words rising in lines above a mouth (口).
計: Say (言) ten (十): counting out loud, the start of any plan.
試: Words (言) in a formal ceremony (式): an exam.
買: A net (罒) scooping up shells (貝), the old money: to buy.
貸: A substitute (代) shell (貝) of money: to lend.
質: Two axes (斤) put up against a shell (貝): the true quality of an item.
赤: A person glowing beside a fire: the person has shrunk to 土 at the top, the flames fill the bottom.
走: A person swinging their arms, feet (龰) flying: to run.
起: Run (走) yourself (己) out of bed: get up.
足: A leg with a kneecap (口) and a foot (龰).
転: A cart's (車) wheel rolling like a cloud (云): turn.
近: An axe (斤) by the road (辶), within reach: nearby.
送: Walk (⻌) someone to the station with two hands of gifts: to send off.
通: A path (甬) you walk along (⻌): pass through.
週: Going around (周) on the road (⻌): the week comes around again.
運: An army (軍) on the march (⻌): to carry.
道: A head (首) going along a road (⻌): the way.
重: A person carrying a big bag: heavy.
野: A village (里) offering (予) open land: a field.
銀: Metal (金) that is stubborn (艮) about staying bright: silver.
開: Two hands lifting the bar from the gate (門): open.
院: A complete (完) group of buildings on a hill (⻖): an institution.
集: Birds (隹) perching in a tree (木): to gather.
青: A green plant growing (龶) under the moon (月): blue-green.
音: A mouth with a sound (日) inside it, standing (立) and humming.
題: A head (頁) bowed over what's correct (是): the topic.
風: A bug (虫) blown under a sail (几): the wind.
飯: Food (飠) that goes against (反) hunger: a meal.
飲: Food (飠) and a wide-open mouth (欠): gulp it down.
館: Food (飠) for officials (官): a big public building.
駅: A horse (馬) measured (尺) by distance: the station where horses were changed.
験: A horse (馬) tested by all (僉): to verify.
魚: A fish, with a head, scaly body and a fin for a tail (the four dots).
鳥: A bird, with a head, body and tail, standing on four toes.
黒: A village (里) stained by fire below: soot-black.
